0.why: LuciControlRND.cpp LuciControlRND::process: the line reads params[RANDOMIZE_INPUT], and RANDOMIZE_INPUT is 0, which is the button; the inputs array is never indexed, commit 215f17aa, the head of the maker’s repository and the only commit carrying version 2.0.0, whose res/ matches the installed panels

LuciControlRND.cpp LuciControlRND::process: the button value of 0 or 1 is added to itself and written out, commit 215f17aa, the head of the maker’s repository and the only commit carrying version 2.0.0, whose res/ matches the installed panels

comment: The maker gave no name to any knob, jack or button on this module, so hovering one shows no tooltip at all. The process function reads params[RANDOMIZE_INPUT] where it plainly meant inputs[RANDOMIZE_INPUT]; since both enumerations start at zero this reads the button twice, so the jack does nothing and the output is double the button.
